messages.en: What are you doing!!!
I got off work, washed up, and now I'm lying downㅠㅠ
Ahh, what a tiring day.
How does it feel promoting again?
It feels like it's been a while.
Maybe because I'm used to promoting as a full group now.
Compared to our previous full-group promotions, there's definitely less mental stress. ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋ
But it's still just as exhausting....

messages.ko: 좋은건 무대할때 응원법 저는 웨이브 구경이나
messages.en: The good part is hearing the fan chants during performances and watching Wav.
Or seeing Wav looking at me with those bright eyes during mini fan meetings.
That's what keeps me going.
I installed Setlog for the first time today.
And I filmed one today.
It'll be a while before it gets uploaded.
So look forward to it.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅅㅅㅋ

messages.ko: 유행에 민감한 여자가 유행 다 지나서 찍으면 어캐
messages.en: What happens when someone who's supposed to be on top of trends films it after the trend is already over?
I've fallen behind now.
Honestly, before...
"Huh? You don't know this?!?" 헉ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ "Wow, you're old." ㄴㅎㅋㅋㅎㅋㄹㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㄹㅋ
That's how I used to think.

messages.ko: 요즘은 나정도면 완전 엠지지~~ 해놓고 이상한 줄임말쓰면 뭐????
messages.en: These days I'll be like, 'I'm totally Gen Z~~,' but then someone uses a weird abbreviation and I'm just like, 'What????'
Then I just figure it out from context.
You've become an old-timer...
Speaking of 'old-timer'...
I had a dream.
All of a sudden, one of my teeth fell out.
It was my canine tooth.
But I had a schedule the next day.
So I was crying my eyes out.
And I made an appointment at the dentist.

messages.ko: 근데 치과에 갔는데 사람이 너무 많아서
messages.en: But when I got there, there were so many people.
The wait was really long.
So I was waiting.

messages.ko: 혀로 이빨 빠진 부분 막 만지고 있는데
messages.en: I kept touching the spot where the tooth fell out with my tongue.
Then I accidentally hit it wrong, and even the tooth next to it and the one below it...
started breaking and falling out.

messages.ko: 내가 더 놀라서 어떡해!!!! 이러면서 이빨이 어디까지 빠졌다 보려고
messages.en: I panicked even more, like, 'What do I do?!?!' while trying to see how many teeth had fallen out.
Then I ran my tongue over them again.
And they just started...
falling out in chunks.
All of my upper teeth fell out.
I only had a few bottom teeth left.
Then the members showed up at the dentist.
I was crying while showing them my teeth.
"All my teeth fell out! What am I supposed to do now?"

messages.ko: 나 평생 틀니로 살아야하냐 이러면서 우는데
messages.en: "Am I going to have to live with dentures for the rest of my life?" I cried.
Meanwhile, the members in front of me...
were holding their stomachs laughing.

messages.ko: 그러다 뒤돌아서 멤버들끼리 뭔 영상 보면서 엄청 웃고 떠들어
messages.en: Then they turned around, watched some video together, and kept laughing and chatting.
Meanwhile I was like, 'What am I supposed to do!! ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ'
"These won't grow back! They're permanent teeth!! ㅠㅠㅠㅠ"
Then everyone suddenly got serious.
They were like, 'We thought you were joking. What happened?'
Then all of a sudden Yooyeon unnie said,

messages.ko: 하연아 근데 틀니 이쁜걸로 맞추면 더 이뻐질수도 있어
messages.en: "Hayeon, but if you get pretty dentures, you might become even prettier."
So I was like, 'Oh... maybe.'
ㅋㅅㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Then I tried calling my mom because I wanted to tell her.
You know how the thing you're trying to do in a dream never works?
I just kept fumbling around.
Eventually I got so frustrated that I yelled, and then I woke up.
As soon as I woke up, I called my mom.
And told her the whole story.
She laughed so hard, then said,
"So... did you get the dentures?"
The dream felt so real that it still bothers me.

messages.ko: 중요한일 앞두고 있거나 스트레스가 많을때 이빨빠지는 꿈꾼대
messages.en: They say people dream about losing their teeth when they're stressed or have something important coming up.
Maybe it was because it was right before promotions.
Oh right! I heard we got 1st place in the Show Champion fan vote!!!!
Thank you so, so much.
Such precious Wav.

messages.ko: 멤버들 다 잘 보일수 있게 해주려는 마음이
messages.en: The fact that you wanted every member to be seen...
is so beautiful..ㅜㅠ
We got first place thanks to the voting skills we built up through Gravity.
So you practiced beforehand? ㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋㅋ
That's cute.

messages.ko: 혹시 선물로 음방 때 찍은 셀카라든가아
messages.en: Maybe as a gift... a selfie you took during music show promotions?
Mmhm.
A gift.
I think I really like myself with bleached hair.
But whenever brown-haired Hayeon shows up...
she looks so pretty.
Maybe because of the contrast.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ I should try lots of different colors.
When else am I going to get the chance?
You know that choreography where you reach your hand forward and sway your hips...? The one that's not from Sad Girl? I really like it.
Oh right.
I was a lot bolder with it during practice.
But since it was a broadcast stage, I held back a little.
So it didn't show up very well, which was a shame.
I'll really show it properly next time we perform a B-side.

messages.ko: 아니 요즘 다들 왤케 날 따라하는거야
messages.en: Seriously, why is everyone copying me these days?

messages.ko: 내가 처음 스타트한 땋머리띠 도 다하구
messages.en: Everyone's doing the braided headband style that I started.
Kim Chaewon even copied my low-rise underwear styling.
I'm going crazy.
She copied my hair color too.
Wait, no.
I meant sagging pants.
The styling we wear on music shows.
That's not what I meant. ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
That came out sounding kind of questionable.
Haha.
"Jeong Hayeon, the role model of tripleS"... let me explain that. ㅎ
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Sorry. ㅋㅎㅋㅋ
My ego's getting way too big.
I'll tone it down a bit.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
That's so funny.
Now what hairstyle should I do?
My brain is overloaded.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Hayeon's current status.
Because there are too many choices?
Yep. ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋ
Guess what I said~
Because there are too many choices?
Correct~
Does using a lip mask make your lips prettier?
It just makes them more moisturized. ㅋㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋ
What if you yawn while wearing a lip mask?
It'll probably go down your throat.
Does it taste good?
Hmm, it's sweet.

messages.ko: 아니 이분 진짜 드시는데 누가 좀 말려야할거같은데
messages.en: No, she's seriously eating it... someone needs to stop her.
It's tasty. ㅎ헿
What? It's not supposed to be eaten?
I know that too. ㅎ
Then what can't you eat?
Anything that's not in front of me.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹ
Hayoi should go to sleep now.
Today was another intense day.
My vitamin,
y/n.
Sleep well.
Dream about anything except your teeth falling out~ ❤️
Bye~
Haranghae 😍
